name: How do I choose the right contractor for my kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select a contractor with general liability and workers' compensation coverage, clear licensing in your municipality, and dedicated kitchen remodeling experience. Ask how they manage project timelines, handle change orders, and protect living areas from dust and debris. Review recent portfolios of completed local kitchens and check references from homeowners who completed similar scopes. A reliable contractor provides a clear written contract detailing scope, payment schedules, and warranty terms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Verify municipal licensing and insurance, review portfolios of similar work, confirm dust control plans, and ensure contracts detail scope and payment terms.
